synopsis: Hey, you sure this rabbit hole's really the way into Archades? / Better a hare unseen than a rat in a trap. / Then again, if you'd prefer to go knocking on the front gates of the city, be my guest. / But what about once we're inside? / Won't the city watch find us? / We'll do what we can to blend into the crowd. / Our names may be notorious, but our faces are not far-known. / True, true. / You're our princess, and we didn't even recognize you. / I noticed.
